CustomField.label: Sync Trigger
CustomField.description: When Salesforce pushes to Veleiro: auto (on record create) | manual (only when the user clicks Sync). Blank defaults to manual. Set it from the Veleiro Mappings panel.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: auto = sincroniza al crear Account/Opportunity; manual = solo al dar clic en el botón Sync. En blanco = manual.
